entries.zh: 挂起来作标记；登记、注册（挂号在册）
entries.en: to put up as a sign or mark; to register, to enter on a register

entries.zh: 日落，太阳下山
entries.en: the sun to set; sunset

entries.zh: 排列，按次序摆好
entries.en: to arrange in order; to line up

entries.zh: 排成行列，列队
entries.en: to arrange into rows; to line up in formation

entries.zh: 排成行列；依次排列
entries.en: to set out in rows; to arrange by rank or order

entries.zh: 报名，说出名字；命名
entries.en: to declare or give a name

entries.zh: 补上名字，在名册或文书上添名
entries.en: to add or supply a name (to a list or document)

entries.zh: 保守秘密；〔西语词头作“着手捕鱼”，与汉字栏不合，疑栏位错位〕
entries.en: to keep a secret (the Spanish headword “to set one's hands to fishing” does not match the Chinese column)
entries.notes: L 与 H 义不相涉，M 亦难通读，暂从汉字栏，存疑。

entries.zh: 交腿，跷腿（把一条腿搭在另一条腿上）
entries.en: to cross one's legs; to lay one leg over the other
entries.notes: H 次字[疑:趾/服]，M 作 cúi 音近“跪”，据 L 定为交腿。

entries.zh: 叠腿（一条腿叠压在另一条腿上）
entries.en: to lay one leg over the other; to cross the legs
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:跌/疊]，M chap 为入声，与“疊”较合；义从 L。

entries.zh: 蹲踞，盘腿蹲坐（一腿压在大腿上）
entries.en: to squat with a leg crossed over the thigh
entries.notes: M 末三音 novuzia 不可解，疑污损衍文；义据 H“蹲踞”与 L。

entries.zh: 挂在心上，记在心里；惦念
entries.en: to fix in the memory or in one's prayers; to keep in mind
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:挂/排]，M 作 cùa，可定为“挂”。

entries.zh: 挂意，放在心上；在意
entries.en: to take to heart; to mind, to care about
entries.notes: H 首字[疑:挂/排]，M 作 cùa，可定为“挂”。

entries.zh: 下网（下鱼笼）捕鱼
entries.en: to set a fishing net or fish trap
entries.notes: H“綾”与 M lēng、L“nas”（鱼梁）不合，疑当作“籠”。

entries.zh: 官府强买（官买，亦或官卖）；〔西语词头作“拘押官员、抄没其财物”，与汉字不合〕
entries.en: official forced purchase (Spanish headword: to arrest the mandarin and seize his goods)
entries.notes: L 与 H 不合，M cūã bēy 可读“官買”亦可读“官賣”，音义两歧，存疑。

entries.zh: 搁在一边收好，放在板上保存
entries.en: to put aside for safekeeping; to lay on a shelf
entries.notes: H“隔”疑为“擱”之借字，M tǔ 或读“貯”（存放），义从 L。

entries.zh: 给斧头加钢（嵌钢口）
entries.en: to steel an axe (to weld a steel edge onto it)
entries.notes: “agez”当即 acero（钢）；H“領斧頭”重在装接斧头，与 L 未尽合。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕西语词头可读作“把钢放到火上”（钢活、淬火）
entries.en: fragmentary: the Spanish reads “to put steel to the fire” (steeling, tempering); the Chinese column cannot be recovered
entries.notes: H 四字与 M 后三音均污损不可通读，仅 L 可辨。

entries.zh: 在十二处街口号名示众；〔西语词头作“把罪犯的四肢分挂于四路口”〕
entries.en: to proclaim a criminal's name at the twelve street-heads (Spanish: to display the quartered body at four crossroads)
entries.notes: L 与 H 仅大略相关，M 六音中四音污损，存疑。

entries.zh: （母鸡）下蛋
entries.en: (of a hen) to lay eggs
entries.notes: [疑:卵/卯]，M 作 nǔy，可定为“卵”。

entries.zh: 潜心，把全部心思放在某事上
entries.en: to put all one's care into something; to devote one's mind to it

entries.zh: 签名（在执照或文书上署名）
entries.en: to sign one's name (on a licence or deed)

entries.zh: 叠起来，一件压一件地堆放
entries.en: to stack one on top of another
entries.notes: M 前二音 T99 污损，义据 L 与 H“叠起來”定。
